claims.text: Alila Seminyak is a beachfront resort steps from the Indian Ocean.

findings.quote: Unfurling along a pristine beach on Bali’s southwest coast, mere steps from the Indian Ocean, Alila Seminyak epitomizes what laid-back luxury looks and feels like. This stunning beachfront resort radiates sophistication
findings.note: The page calls it a beachfront resort steps from the Indian Ocean.

claims.text: The resort occupies the quieter end of a beach that stretches north from Kuta and Legian.

findings.quote: Alila Seminyak occupies the quieter end of a sun-drenched beach that stretches 5 miles north from Kuta and Legian.
findings.note: Matches the claim directly.

claims.text: Seminyak offers beginner surfing, sunsets and beach clubs including Ku De Ta and Potato Head.

findings.quote: Seminyak combines great beginner surfing, legendary sunsets and some of Bali’s most glamorous beach clubs, including Ku De Ta and Potato Head.
findings.note: Covers beginner surfing, sunsets and both named beach clubs.

claims.text: The resort is near the Pura Petitenget temple, where traditional dance rehearsals take place at the Bale Agung pavilion across the temple.

findings.quote: Temple culture is a big part of Balinese life, and Alila Seminyak is near one of its most unique temples, Pura Petitenget.
findings.note: Establishes that the resort is near Pura Petitenget.

findings.quote: take in traditional dance rehearsals at the Bale Agung pavilion across the temple
findings.note: Establishes the dance rehearsals at the Bale Agung pavilion.

claims.text: Rooms and suites combine contemporary Balinese design, and each has a private terrace or balcony.

findings.quote: Our rooms and suites weave contemporary Balinese design with thoughtful amenities and stunning views. These serene hideaways each feature a private terrace or balcony for seamless indoor-outdoor living.
findings.note: Covers both the design and the private terrace or balcony in each room.

claims.text: The fitness centre has a gym and the Movement Studio, a dedicated space for yoga and mindful practice, with floor-to-ceiling windows.

findings.quote: The fitness centre at Alila Seminyak features a gym with state-of-the-art equipment and the Movement Studio - a dedicated space for yoga and mindful practice. Flooded with natural light from floor-to-ceiling windows throughout
findings.note: Covers the gym, the Movement Studio and the floor-to-ceiling windows.

claims.text: Resort activities include morning yoga, sound bath meditation, mat Pilates, Balinese dance, creative workshops and face painting for younger guests.

findings.quote: from morning yoga, sound bath meditation, and mat Pilates to Balinese dance, creative workshops, and playful face painting for younger guests.
findings.note: Every listed activity is named.

claims.text: Play Alila offers activities designed for younger guests.

findings.quote: Playtime perfection awaits younger guests at Play Alila. Unleash their imagination through fun-filled activities designed just for them.
findings.note: Matches the claim directly.

claims.text: The resort's green initiatives include property planning that works with the natural landscape, its own hydroponic garden and support for local schools.

findings.quote: The resort’s green initiatives range from sensitive property planning that works with the natural landscape to growing our own hydroponic garden and supporting local schools.
findings.note: Covers all three initiatives.

claims.text: Condé Nast Traveler describes the design as clean lines and minimalist furniture, with a rooftop bar.

findings.quote: think clean lines, minimalist furniture, and a buzzy rooftop watering hole
findings.note: The review describes clean lines, minimalist furniture and a rooftop bar ('watering hole').

claims.text: Seasalt restaurant serves wild-caught and sustainably harvested seafood from local waters.

findings.quote: Alila Seminyak honors this longstanding tradition with Seasalt and its menu of wild-caught and sustainably harvested seafood from local waters.
findings.note: Matches the claim directly.

claims.text: The Beach Bar has daybeds and lounge chairs, with Alila signature cocktails, thin-crust pizzas and Mediterranean bites.

findings.quote: Sink into the comfort of a daybed or lounge chair with an aperitif or an Alila signature cocktail, served alongside thin-crust pizzas and Mediterranean bites.
findings.note: Covers the daybeds, lounge chairs, cocktails, pizzas and Mediterranean bites.

claims.text: The resort has five infinity pools integrated throughout the grounds, including the Main Pool attached to the Beach Bar, the Family Pool and the Serene Pool.

findings.quote: Beat the tropical heat with a dip in our infinity swimming pools, five in all, integrated throughout the grounds of the resort, including the Main Pool attached to Beach Bar, the Family Pool, and the Serene Pool.
findings.note: Covers the count of five and all three named pools.

claims.text: The Alila Penthouse has three king bedrooms, a separate living area, a private pool, a sun deck and multiple balconies.

findings.quote: Take in sweeping island views from this 811 sqm penthouse suite, furnished with three king bedrooms, separate living area, private pool, sun deck, and multiple balconies.
findings.note: Every listed feature is covered.

claims.text: The resort has its own Segara Temple, where guests can take part in a Melukat water blessing led by the temple priest, Bapak Mangku.

findings.quote: Explore Alila’s own Segara Temple, where stories of the land and spiritual legacy are shared with care and meaning.
findings.note: Establishes that the resort has its own Segara Temple.

findings.quote: Participate in a Melukat water blessing led by Bapak Mangku, the temple priest, to cleanse and recalibrate body, mind and spirit.
findings.note: Establishes the Melukat blessing led by the temple priest, Bapak Mangku.

claims.text: The Beach Suite, one of the hotel's largest, has two separate living areas, a dining area and a wraparound balcony with beach views.

findings.quote: Unwind in this 177 sqm suite, one of the hotel’s largest, with one king bed, two separate living areas, a dining area, and a furnished wraparound balcony with beach views.
findings.note: Every element of the claim is covered.

claims.text: Spa Alila offers therapeutic massages, including the signature Alila Seminyak Massage, and guests can customize their own wellness rituals.

findings.quote: Choose from an extensive selection of therapeutic massages, including the signature Alila Seminyak Massage, or customize your own wellness rituals.
findings.note: Matches the claim directly.

claims.text: Ngurah Rai International Airport is 12 kilometers from the hotel.

findings.quote: Ngurah Rai International Airport (DPS)12 kilometers
findings.note: Gives the airport distance as 12 kilometers.

claims.text: WhataHotel notes the busy Seminyak area draws tourist crowds.
WhataHotel notes premium pricing that reflects the luxury positioning.
